data.reason: Provisional full-text workflow checkpoint, not a scientific eligibility inclusion. On 2026-11-10, agent tool-mediated rendering directly displayed the Chalmers-cover version of the original ACM Transactions on Human-Robot Interaction 14(2), Article 33, DOI 10.1145/3711938 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 at printed 33:1 (PDF page 2). Original §§2.1–2.4 (printed 33:5–33:10) distinguish an online video-based repair-strategy pilot recruiting via Prolific (author reports 50 participants) from a physical maze human–Pepper between-subject study (author reports 60 participants) manipulating default versus custom synthetic voice and repair strategy, 2x3 conditions, with spoken recommendations, acceptance latency/behaviour and post-task trust ratings; selected §3 Results/§4 Discussion consulted. This supports genuine preliminary E1–E6 assessment of the main maze study, but published phase labels do not warrant two independently counted samples or a merge/split with Romeo 2023, a distinct IEEE DOI. Chalmers adds a volatile PDF wrapper; source owners have not retained/registered the exact version rendered here, and 2023 original text is still missing. Keep full-text eligibility pending exact-byte R004/Integration registration and source-pinned reading/identity evaluation; no sound files played or statistics extracted.
